videos.title: Unicornicycle
videos.overview: A precocious girl demands that Jimmy and his team make two unicorn bicycles that — checks notes — "fart glitter." And you thought your boss was tough.

videos.title: Soccer Shoe Car
videos.overview: The beautiful game of soccer will never be the same after Jimmy and company hit the pitch with a "Panda Paradise Soccer Shoe Car."

videos.title: Rock Paper Scissors
videos.overview: Nobody likes to lose at rock paper scissors, but this supersized contest between the makers has especially high stakes.

videos.title: Nuclear Nutcracker
videos.overview: The guys go all out to create a humongous nutcracker that slices, dices and destroys anything in its way. It also makes smoothies for some reason.

videos.title: Catapoop vs Trepoochet
videos.overview: The makers are given a mission: construct two catapults that will fling cat poop as far and as high as possible. Because, why the heck not?

videos.title: Pirate Pizza Cannon
videos.overview: A fearsome new maker joins Jimmy's mighty crew to construct a pirate pizza ship and a pie-launching cannon for a landlubbin' lad and lass.

videos.title: Guitar Boat
videos.overview: Can five bearded makers build a guitar-shaped boat that holds two passengers, plays music and actually floats? Only one way to find out, sailor.
